why: A proof removed from a default suite is one nobody runs unless something names it. This roster is that name. scripts/product-reality/run-on-demand-gates.mjs runs every entry, pre-freeze part B calls that one script, and packages/mcp-server/test/product-reality/gate-roster.s204.spec.ts asserts the roster agrees with the configs it describes.

gates.proves: each of the eight runtime gates detects a unique injected defect on both framework targets
gates.movesWhen: the gate harness (scripts/product-reality/s184-m06-*) or the generation path changes

measuredCost.note: 336s in the Sprint 203 run, which was measured at load average 24.6 on 8 cores
the 1000-tier dry run measures ~1.2s per its config; not separately measured in s204-m01

gates.removedIn: decision #614 (s105-m03); already a standing closeout gate, listed here so one roster holds every on-demand gate
